item.title: Buttons
item.description:
Buttons with links. If the button contains an external link, it will open in a new tab. Also the rel attribute is added with the values noreferrer noopener and nofollow.

Syntax # 

{{< button name="Repository" type="primary" icon="github" >}}

Options #

  • href: Url or destination route. (required)
  • name: Button name. (required)
  • type: Type that defines the colors. Valid values: primary (optional)
  • icon: The name of a Meteor Icons icon. (optional)

Example # 

{{< button href="/docs/1.8/starting" name="Home" type="primary" icon="book-open" >}}
{{< button href="https://github.com" name="Repository" icon="github" >}}

Home Repository

item.title: Code
item.description:
Create explanatory code blocks, more powerful than normal code blocks.

Syntax # 

{{< code >}}
...content
{{< /code >}}

Options #

  • id: Unique identifier. (optional)
  • class: Additional CSS classes. (optional)
  • hl: Highlighted lines. (optional)
  • lang: Language type. By default: html. (optional)
  • example: Interpret example code, only valid for html (mandatory in all cases), css and javascript: true, false. By default: false (optional)

Tab options #

  • Get 0: Language type. By default: html. (optional)
  • Get 1: File name. (optional)

Example # 

{{< code >}}
...content
{{< /code >}}

Code with example # 

{{< code example=true >}}
A paragraph with a <strong>Bold</strong> and an <em>Italic</em>
{{< /code >}}

Code explained # 

{{< code lang="js" >}}
document.querySelector("body");
<---->
This code is selecting the body of the document.
{{< /code >}}

Code with tabs # 

{{< code >}}
{{< tab "html" >}}
...content
{{< /tab >}}
{{< tab "css" >}}
...content
{{< /tab >}}
{{< tab "js" "main.js" >}}
...content
{{< /tab >}}
{{< /code >}}

item.title: Columns
item.description:
Create easily column of content, useful to group more information in the same segment.

Syntax # 

{{< columns >}}
...content
<---->
...content
<---->
...content
{{< /columns >}}

Options #

  • Get 0: Additional CSS classes. (optional)

Example # 

{{< columns >}}
### Medicine
As young doctors working in acute...
<---->
### Countries
All this from an island of just...
<---->
### History
The artist Christo, known for wrapping buildings...
{{< /columns >}}

item.title: Hint
item.description:
Highlight different types of messages with styles based on the context.

Syntax # 

{{< hint >}}
...content
{{< /hint >}}

Options #

  • Get 0: Alert style. Valid values: `info`, `success`, `danger`, `warning` (optional)

Example # 

{{< hint >}}
Message with normal information, without styles
{{< /hint >}}
Message with normal information, without styles
{{< hint "info" >}}
Message with advice or data-style information
{{< /hint >}}
Message with advice or data-style information
{{< hint "success" >}}
Message to indicate good actions or accomplishments
{{< /hint >}}
Message to indicate good actions or accomplishments
{{< hint "warning" >}}
Warning message or attention required
{{< /hint >}}
Warning message or attention required
{{< hint "danger" >}}
Error message or actions that require caution
{{< /hint >}}

item.title: Page Link
item.description:
Page links. If the link is external, it will open in a new window. It also includes the rel attribute with the values “noreferrer” and “noopener”.

Syntax # 

{{< pagelink title="Search Page" name="Google" href="https://google.com" >}}

Options #

  • href: Absolute or explicit path of the link. If the path belongs to an external link, the rel and target attributes will be added automatically. (required)
  • title: Title of the link. Default value: “undefined” (required)
  • icon: The name of a Meteor Icons icon. (optional)
  • name: Name of the page where the link comes from. (optional)

Example # 

{{< pagelink title="Documentation Start" href="/docs/1.8/starting" >}}
{{< pagelink title="Search Page" name="Google" href="https://google.com" >}}
Documentation Start Search Page

item.title: Tables
item.description:
By default, tables generated with markdown syntax are not responsive. To partially solve this problem, enclose your tables with this shortcode.

Syntax # 

{{< table >}}
...table
{{< /table >}}

Options #

  • Get 0: Additional CSS classes. (optional)

Example # 

{{< table >}}
| Syntax | Description |
| --- | ----------- |
| Header | Title |
| Paragraph | Text |
{{< /table >}}
Syntax Description
Header Title
Paragraph Text
